title: Arcane Alchemist Ritual
description: A blue-skinned alchemist in green robes pours a yellow potion into a glowing bowl on a desk filled with spellbooks, candles, and potion bottles. Behind him, a large ornate mirror shows a swirling orange vortex with four fairies, while a woman in pink armor casts a pink energy beam toward a floating portal as a mantis and beetle hover above in a cosmic night sky with a distant castle.
prompt: A blue-skinned fantasy alchemist wearing green and purple robes sits at a wooden desk pouring a glowing yellow potion into a bowl. An ornate black mirror behind him displays a swirling orange vortex surrounded by four colorful fairies. To the right, a woman in shiny pink armor and boots sits on cushions casting a bright pink energy beam into a circular blue and pink portal. A large green mantis and a beetle float near the ceiling. The background shows a starry cosmic sky and a gothic castle. The desk is covered with lit candles, colorful potion bottles, an open spellbook titled 'STRAS' with spider drawings, and magical items.
